accessNotes: Style guide page and GitHub source (last pushed 2020) fully readable. Chart example images were captured by screenshotting the live Highcharts demos on the style-guide page (the demo page overrides series colours per example, e.g. orange/yellow and green, so colours in screenshots are not the Highcharts default palette).
summary: News-apps style kit for MinnPost (Minnesota nonprofit newsroom) built on Highcharts + SCSS. Charts are clean and light: Open Sans 12px light-grey labels, dotted horizontal gridlines, no chart title (component label/caption in HTML above), bold dark-grey legend at the top, thick 4px lines without markers, blue-teal data palette. Political party colours and Chroma.js-generated sequential/diverging scales are provided.

colors.categoricalNotes: Highcharts default colors are the three blues (blue1 #0D57A0, blue2 #0793AB, blue3 #55CBDD). Full 'colors-data' starting set: green1 #1D8C47, green2 #32955D, green3 #36A174, purple #55307E, blue1 #0D57A0, blue2 #0793AB, blue3 #55CBDD, red #C83D2D, orange #FF6633, yellow #FBD341 — 'colors to start from, and the set as whole should not necessarily be used to represent categories'. No more than 7 groups/colours. Political: DFL/D #0793AB, GOP/R #A1000F, IP #FF781F, Green #07AB20, Grassroots/Legal Marijuana #41AB07, LMN #286806, minor parties #7A7A7A.
colors.notes: Highcharts colorDark #676767 (axis titles, legend, tooltip text), colorLight #BCBCBC (general text/tick labels, x-axis line and ticks), colorLighter DEDEDE (y-axis line; written without '#' in source). Sequential examples are generated with Chroma.js from white to a hue in Lab/HCL (e.g. chroma.scale(['white', '#F55F29']).mode('lab')); diverging go to the 'opposite ordered hue'. Interface: MinnPost red #801019 (brand), link blue #0084A8, heading #282828, text #404040, gray #7A7A7A, light gray #ABABAB, lighter #CCCCCC, lightest #F8F8F8. Colour-blind check with Color Oracle.

axisTitle.placement: y title rotated, left (enabled by default, 'Units (un)' pattern); x title disabled by default

typography.notes: Highcharts title disabled; chart title is an HTML .component-label (Montserrat bold, 1.25×16px=20px) above the chart, followed by a .caption (0.85em). Headings use Montserrat; body Open Sans. Legend items bold 14px #676767. Credits/footnotes .credit 0.85em #ABABAB (footnote with 1px #ABABAB top border).

structure.gridlines: Horizontal (y) gridlines only, dotted ('gridLineDashStyle: Dot'), light grey; no vertical grid except value-axis grid on horizontal bar charts.
structure.axisLine: x-axis line #BCBCBC with ticks; y-axis line colour #DEDEDE (Highcharts default width 0, so effectively none).
structure.yAxisTitle: rotated, bold #676767 12px, margin 20 ('Units (un)'); turned off when caption explains units
structure.unitPlacement: In tick labels (e.g. '$40,000') or y-axis title 'Units (un)' with unit abbreviation in parentheses
structure.notes: Charts use class .chart: width 100%, height 20em, margin-bottom 2em. No Highcharts credits.

legend.placement: top, centred (Highcharts cannot left-align; source TODO says 'align legend left'), margin 30, item distance 20, no border
legend.directLabels: Not used; guide says leave the legend off if a caption can describe it
legend.title: no
legend.swatchShape: rounded rectangle for bars, marker symbol for scatter

marks.bars: Highcharts default bar/column widths; minPointLength 3 so tiny values remain visible; no borders/rounding.
marks.lines: lineWidth 4 (5 on hover); markers disabled, shown on hover as white-filled circles with 2px series-colour outline.
marks.points: Scatter marker radius 5 with 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.2) outline (opaque white on hover).

labels.dataLabels: Not default; tooltip shows 'Series: value' with value as integer with thousands separator.
labels.numberFormat: Comma thousands separator, default 2 decimals (formatters.number); currency '$' + 2 decimals; percent 1 decimal + '%'; changes prefixed '+'. Axis example '${value:,.0f}'. Highcharts k abbreviations (10k) appear by default.

furniture.title: No in-chart title. HTML .component-label (bold Montserrat 20px) then .caption (small) above chart: 'Your awesome, concise caption goes here.'
furniture.source: .credit/.footnote small light-grey text below (0.85em #ABABAB); no fixed 'Source:' pattern in chart lib.
furniture.other: Responsive breakpoints 420/640/960/1200px; article width 640px, full width 960px.

layout: Chart container 100% width × 20em height; article column 640px.
interaction: Highcharts tooltip: Open Sans 12px #676767, HTML, 'Series name: value'. Lines thicken to 5px on hover and show markers.
accessibility: Max ~7 colours; choose distinct colours in HCL/Lab; check colour-blindness with Color Oracle.

chartTypes.notes: Default option sets exist only for line, column, bar and scatter.

distinctiveRules.rule: No Highcharts title or credits; title is an HTML component label (bold Montserrat) and a short caption above the chart.
distinctiveRules.quote: title: { enabled: false, text: null }, credits: { enabled: false }

distinctiveRules.rule: Horizontal gridlines only, dotted light grey.
All chart text Open Sans 12px in light grey #BCBCBC; axis titles and legend in bold dark grey #676767.
distinctiveRules.quote: styleGeneral = { fontSize: '12px', color: colorLight } ... styleLabel = { fontWeight: 'bold', color: colorDark }

distinctiveRules.rule: Legend at top (centered), borderless, bold 14px labels, 30px margin to plot.
distinctiveRules.quote: legend: { margin: 30, verticalAlign: 'top', borderWidth: 0, itemDistance: 20, itemStyle: styleLabelLarge }

distinctiveRules.rule: Lines are thick (4px) with no markers; markers appear on hover as white-filled circles.
distinctiveRules.quote: line: { lineWidth: 4, marker: { fillColor: '#FFFFFF', lineWidth: 2, enabled: false } }

distinctiveRules.rule: Y axis always starts at 0 and has a rotated bold title like 'Units (un)'; x-axis title off.
distinctiveRules.quote: yAxis: { title: { enabled: true, text: 'Units (un)' }, min: 0 }

distinctiveRules.rule: Default series colours are three blues: #0D57A0, #0793AB, #55CBDD.
Bars/columns get a minimum visible length of 3px.
Leave axis labels and legend off when the caption can describe them.
distinctiveRules.quote: If you can adequately describe your x-axis units and labels, leave them and the legend off.

distinctiveRules.rule: Use no more than 7 colours for groups; sequential scales go from white to a hue in Lab/HCL.
distinctiveRules.quote: It is suggested to break things down to no more than 7 colors.

distinctiveRules.rule: Fixed political party colours: DFL/D teal-blue #0793AB, GOP/R dark red #A1000F, IP orange #FF781F, minor parties grey #7A7A7A.
Tooltip content: bold series name, colon, integer value with thousands separators.

referenceImages.describes: Live line-chart demo: single thick (~4px) Highcharts-blue line (demo override), no markers, no title or legend. Dotted light-grey horizontal gridlines only; y labels left in grey Open Sans with currency format '$10,000'...'$40,000', y starts at $0; thin grey x-axis line with tick marks, x labels 0–60. White background.

Horizontal bar demo with two series (orange #FF6633-ish 'Example' and yellow #FBD341-ish 'Example 2', demo overrides). Legend centred at top with rounded-square swatches and bold dark-grey labels. Dotted vertical gridlines on value axis, thin grey category axis line with ticks; tick labels light grey (0k–30k); bold grey axis title 'Units (un)' centred below. Bars thin, flat, no rounding.

Scatterplot demo: green circles (r≈5) with faint white outline and light-blue diamonds; legend top-centre with marker symbols and bold dark-grey labels. Dotted horizontal gridlines, solid grey x axis with ticks; rotated bold grey y title 'Units (un)' and bold x title below.
Column demo: many thin green columns, y axis 0k–40k with dotted horizontal gridlines, rotated bold grey 'Units (un)' y title, light-grey tick labels, no legend/title.
